image_description: Two men in outdoor fishing gear (red rain suit and green jacket) standing on a boat, holding a large sturgeon horizontally. The background shows a river or lake with forested hills and overcast sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish's head is clearly elongated and the mouth is positioned on the underside (ventral), consistent with sturgeon anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Four distinct barbel structures are visible hanging from the snout area in front of the mouth.
The snout tapers to a distinct point at the anterior end of the fish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body is long, torpedo-shaped (fusiform), and appears large relative to the holders, matching the 'impressively large' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of bony plates (scutes) are visible along the lateral line and dorsal ridge; no typical fish scales are present.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The top of the fish is dark gray/brown, transitioning to a white/lighter belly, matching the coloration checkpoint.
The tail fin is visibly asymmetrical, with the upper lobe extending further than the lower lobe, characteristic of heterocercal tails.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identity and rule out look-alike primitive fish.
To verify the integrity of the scutes and ensure no fusion artifacts between the fish and the holders' hands.
To check for subtle texture inconsistencies in the skin/scutes and lighting coherence between subjects and background.
To provide bounding box priors for the humans and fish to assist boundary auditing.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the scutes; AI often renders them as uniform bumps rather than irregular bony plates. Verify that the barbels do not merge into the snout or disappear. Check the hands holding the fish for any 'melting' into the fish's body or missing fingers.
